editionLabel: IELLO German base rules distributed by Hutter Trade, English summary
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited London is the starting player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player receives the wire cutters and reveals a wire card belonging to another player. A player cannot cut their own wire.
